verdict.rationale: Bench documents an in-app AI Categorization Assistant that suggests a category in real time when you describe a transaction, and it says business patterns automatically generate categorization rules. That is AI-driven suggestion from user data, but it is limited to transaction categorization; reports and dashboards are standard financial statements with no stated AI analysis. Missing for 10: AI-generated financial insights beyond categorization (e.g., spending anomalies, forecasts, natural-language Q&A over the books), in-depth docs on the AI features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
